cpmplus.w2tools.budget.menu.desc: Shows, for each safety setting other players use, whether your model loads for them (parts, texture size, file size, animated textures). Read only: nothing is changed
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.title: Who can see my model?
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.intro: You always see your own model. Other players only see it if it fits their safety settings. This is information only: nothing was changed.
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.row.sizeInline: Size: %s KB (fits in the model file)
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.row.sizeLink: Size: %s KB (needs a link: %s KB download)
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.why.animTex: animated textures are off: the texture stands still
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.linkNote: Your model is bigger than the 30 KB the model file holds, so it goes through a link (gist / paste). That is normal. Players download %s KB.
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.skinNote: If you apply it through the skin (export to skin), the space there is small and it usually goes through a link: %s KB download.
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.epicFight: Note (our own analysis, not a CPM rule): with Epic Fight / xfight, models above 256 parts (yours: %s) are drawn more slowly in crowds.
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.cpmLevel: CPM editor's own safety level for this model: %s.
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.layersNone: No animation switched by skin layers.
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.layersOk: Animations switched by skin layers: %s, free layers: %s (fits up to %s).
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.layersBad: Animations switched by skin layers: %s, but %s free layers only fit %s. The export breaks: open the skin layer settings or turn some of them off.
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.layersDefault: (no layers chosen yet: we used the ones your skin leaves free; CPM asks when you export in game)
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.convertFailed: Could not convert the model to measure it: %s. Use CPM+ > Check model to find the problem.
cpmplus.w2tools.budget.footer: Information only, nothing was changed. To find problems in the model use CPM+ > Check model.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.menu.desc: Imports the animations of a .animation.json file and lets you choose which part of your model each bone moves
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.title: Import Bedrock/GeckoLib animation
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.intro: File: %s. Choose which part of your model each bone of the file moves. Bones "without a pair" are left out.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.animsHead: Animations to import (the name after the arrow is the one it gets here):
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.bonesHead: Bone of the file -> part of your model:
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.molangInfo: Some movements use formulas (Molang). They stay as they are here; the CPM+ export turns them into frames.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.pivotInfo: Bedrock / GeckoLib models have other pivots: the movement is applied as a change from the rest pose of your model, so it may need small adjustments.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.sum.effects: Sounds / particles do not exist in CPM and were left out in: %s
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.sum.layers: Warning: %s animations are switched by skin layers but %s free layers only fit %s; the export will complain.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.sum.next: They were created as custom poses. Click here to change the type.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.err.notJson: "%s" is not a Bedrock / GeckoLib animation file (it is not valid JSON).
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.err.noAnims: "%s" has no animations (no "animations" section). Animation controllers can not be imported.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.err.noImport: This Blockbench can not open files here.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.err.noLoader: This Blockbench has no Bedrock animation loader. Update Blockbench and try again.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.err.noPairs: No bone has a pair: choose a part of your model for at least one bone.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.err.sameGroup: "%s" and "%s" both point to "%s". Each part of your model can receive only one bone.
cpmplus.w2tools.bedrock.err.groupGone: The part chosen for "%s" no longer exists. Open the import again.
